Task / Business Action: Configure business settings
Business Outcome: Configure company profile, legal name, registered address, logo, currency, and financial year
Downstream Impact: Updates Company master model; sets default behaviors for documents and system operations
Notes: Supported via /settings/company/ profile management.

Task / Business Action: Customer changes legal name and registered address: system updates master while preserving historical invoices
Business Outcome: Customer moves to new premises and updates GSTIN; new invoices use new address, historical invoices preserve old address
Downstream Impact: Updates Customer master; historical completed SalesInvoice headers retain immutable address snapshot
Notes: Core data invariant: invoice headers store immutable address snapshot; master updates do not corrupt historical bills.

Task / Business Action: Record a cash sale
Business Outcome: Immediate cash payment accepted and registered in the daily till
Downstream Impact: Debit Cash-in-Hand ledger account, credit Sales Revenue account; updates physical till balance
Notes: Supported via Payment model (payment_mode='CASH') linked directly to completed SalesInvoice.

Task / Business Action: Record a UPI/digital payment
Business Outcome: Instant settlement via dynamic BharatPe/UPI QR code scanning
Downstream Impact: Debit Bank/UPI Settlement clearing account, credit Sales Revenue account; records transaction UTR/ref
Notes: Supported via POS screen dynamic UPI QR generator. Stores transaction UTR reference on payment record.

Task / Business Action: Automated payment gateway webhook signature cryptographic verification worker
Business Outcome: Ensure payment gateway callback authenticity and reject fraudulent spoofed payment completion requests
Downstream Impact: Verifies HMAC SHA-256 signature using webhook secret; rejects unverified payload with HTTP 400
Notes: Core security invariant: HMAC signature verification required before marking invoice PAID.

Task / Business Action: Automated recurring subscription billing and GST tax invoice generation via Razorpay Subscriptions
Business Outcome: Automated monthly/annual recurring credit card / UPI auto-debit for software subscription fee
Downstream Impact: Charges customer; activates subscription period; automatically emails GST-compliant B2B SaaS tax invoice
Notes: Razorpay / Stripe recurring subscription webhook integration with automated invoice delivery.

Task / Business Action: Handle bounced / dishonoured cheque: reverse invoice settlement, add bank fee, alert owner
Business Outcome: Immediate accounting reversal when bank rejects cheque due to insufficient customer funds
Downstream Impact: Restores original invoice UNPAID status; debits bank dishonour charges to customer account; alerts owner
Notes: Supported via Cheque Dishonour action with automated ledger reversal and notice letter.

Task / Business Action: Customer cheque dishonoured after 5 days: automated accounting reversal and bank fee debit
Business Outcome: ₹50,000 cheque bounces; system reverses invoice payment, marks bill UNPAID, debits ₹350 bank bounce fee to customer
Downstream Impact: Generates formal legal cheque bounce notice under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act; alerts owner
Notes: Automated Cheque Dishonour workflow with Section 138 statutory notice letter generator.

Task / Business Action: Complete the pay run and keep one payslip per active employee
Business Outcome: The month is closed for pay and can be reopened only through the pay-run actions
Downstream Impact: complete_pay_run writes PaySlip rows and can pay from cash. A completed run cannot be completed again
Notes: complete_pay_run. There are no bonus, arrear, advance, or one-off deduction lines on a slip.

Task / Business Action: Deterministic LLM bill extraction: photo of crumpled paper bill → structured draft invoice
Business Outcome: Merchant snaps photo of physical vendor bill using mobile camera; AI extracts line items with 99% accuracy
Downstream Impact: Parses vendor GSTIN, invoice number, items, HSN, rates, and taxes; pre-fills purchase invoice in 5 seconds
Notes: Differentiator vs Tally/Vyapar: Vision LLM + OCR parsing pipeline with deterministic schema validation.

Task / Business Action: Record purchases by batch
Business Outcome: Inward medicine purchases capturing manufacturer batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, and MRP
Downstream Impact: Creates or updates BatchLot records; increments batch quantity and updates latest purchase rate
Notes: Supported via /purchases/invoices/create with batch lot table inputs per line item.

Task / Business Action: Predictive cash-flow simulation engine modeling actual debtor payment delay probabilities
Business Outcome: Simulates 30-day cash balance incorporating probabilistic model of which specific debtors pay late
Downstream Impact: Warns owner: 'You will face a ₹2.4 Lakh cash deficit on the 22nd due to GST payment; chase Sharma today'
Notes: Differentiator vs standard reports: Monte Carlo cashflow simulation factoring historical debtor delay.

Task / Business Action: See today's business performance
Business Outcome: Morning and evening executive snapshot of daily sales, cash collections, and pending orders
Downstream Impact: Displays high-level KPI cards (Total Sales, Cash In, Unpaid Bills, Net Margin) on mobile or desktop
Notes: Supported via Owner Executive Dashboard and automated daily summary WhatsApp/Email digest.

Task / Business Action: Automated background trial balance zero-sum verification worker
Business Outcome: Continuous verification that sum of all debits equals sum of all credits across the entire company GL
Downstream Impact: Triggers high-priority alert if debit-credit discrepancy != 0; quarantines corrupted ledger batches
Notes: Trial-balance reporting exists in accounting.reports.trial_balance, and books health exposes trial_balance_balanced. No hourly Celery beat task that quarantines unbalanced batches was found.

Task / Business Action: ESC/POS thermal receipt printer direct driver integration via USB, Bluetooth & Network
Business Outcome: Sub-second direct silent printing on 2-inch and 3-inch thermal printers without opening browser print dialog
Downstream Impact: Sends raw ESC/POS command bytes directly to printer port; automatically triggers cash drawer kick-out
Notes: WebUSB and WebBluetooth ESC/POS driver supporting Epson, TVS, and thermal receipt printers.

Task / Business Action: Barcode scanner HID USB wedge and 2D QR camera barcode reader
Business Outcome: Supports standard handheld 1D laser barcode guns, 2D QR scanners, and mobile device built-in camera
Downstream Impact: Captures scanned barcode strings with automatic Enter delimiter; opens product in cart instantly
Notes: Universal HID keyboard wedge listener with 50ms keystroke timing heuristic + HTML5 camera scanner.

Task / Business Action: Create a quick bill for a walk-in customer
Business Outcome: Instant checkout within 15 seconds; printed or digital receipt handed over; minimal queue delay
Downstream Impact: Stock decremented atomically in inventory ledger; cash drawer balance increased; sales voucher posted to GL
Notes: Supported via /pos rapid checkout. Barcode/touch selection, instant cash tender, thermal slip print.

Task / Business Action: Create a customer invoice
Business Outcome: Compliant retail invoice issued with itemized rates, discounts, and payment terms
Downstream Impact: Stock decremented, customer ledger updated (if credit), sales revenue posted to GL
Notes: Supported via /sales/invoices/create and /pos rapid checkout.

Task / Business Action: Sell medicines with batch information
Business Outcome: Dispense prescription/OTC medicines with mandatory batch number, expiry date, and MRP printed on bill
Downstream Impact: Decrements specific BatchLot stock; captures batch and expiry on SalesItem for statutory traceability
Notes: Supported via /pos and /sales/invoices/ with batch-selector popup and FEFO pre-selection.

Task / Business Action: Search medicines while billing
Business Outcome: Rapid search by brand name, generic composition / salt name, or barcode during billing
Downstream Impact: Queries product catalog and active batch lots; displays composition, manufacturer, and stock
Notes: Supported via multi-field indexed search (brand, salt, manufacturer, barcode) on POS.

Task / Business Action: Create bulk sales invoices
Business Outcome: Create high-volume B2B tax invoices with tiered wholesale price lists, discounts, and credit terms
Downstream Impact: Decrements warehouse stock, debits customer AR ledger, generates GST B2B tax invoice
Notes: Supported via /sales/invoices/ with wholesale price list auto-application and bulk CSV entry.

Task / Business Action: Sub-200ms POS billing checkout latency under continuous queue load
Business Outcome: Cashier can complete sales invoices with < 200ms round-trip API response time during peak festival rush
Downstream Impact: Eliminates billing delays; handles 100+ checkouts per minute across store network without lag
Notes: Optimized checkout transaction benchmarked via Locust load test to < 200ms P95 latency.

Task / Business Action: Offline-first POS billing queue with automatic background sync upon internet recovery
Business Outcome: Cashier can continue scanning, billing, and printing thermal receipts when store broadband drops
Downstream Impact: Queues bills in local IndexedDB outbox; auto-synchronizes and reconciles with server when internet returns
Notes: ServiceWorker offline billing engine with background sync and server idempotency key reconciliation.

Task / Business Action: Idempotent API design guaranteeing zero duplicate orders on network timeout retries
Business Outcome: Prevent accidental duplicate billing if user clicks 'Pay' twice or mobile app retries dropped connection
Downstream Impact: Uses client-generated X-Idempotency-Key; returns existing transaction if duplicate key is received
Notes: Idempotency middleware caching endpoint response in Redis for 120 seconds.

Task / Business Action: Atomic database sequence locking preventing concurrent invoice numbering gaps
Business Outcome: Guarantee zero missing numbers in statutory invoice sequences even under heavy concurrent billing
Downstream Impact: Uses PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE on DocumentSequence row; strictly guarantees sequential numbering
Notes: Postgres row-level lock on sequence master; strictly satisfies GST Rule 46 sequentiality mandate.

Task / Business Action: Customer exceeds credit limit → sale/order is flagged or blocked
Business Outcome: Prevent excessive credit exposure by blocking sales to over-limit customers
Downstream Impact: Validates current customer balance + cart total against credit_limit; blocks checkout
Notes: Core business invariant: hard validation guard; requires Owner override token to bypass.

Task / Business Action: Concurrent checkout conflict: two cashiers bill last remaining stock unit simultaneously
Business Outcome: First cashier's checkout succeeds; second cashier receives immediate graceful notification: 'Item out of stock'
Downstream Impact: Prevents negative inventory; prompts second cashier with alternative brand suggestions without crashing cart
Notes: Enforced via SELECT FOR UPDATE row-level lock on StockBalance; handles concurrent race condition cleanly.

Task / Business Action: Credit limit breach during bulk invoice: owner sends temporary one-time authorization token
Business Outcome: Customer cart exceeds credit limit; clerk sends 1-click WhatsApp approval request to owner; owner taps 'Approve'
Downstream Impact: Authorizes specific invoice without permanently raising customer credit limit; checkout unfreezes immediately
Notes: Temporary credit limit override token with 15-minute expiration and audit trail stamp.

Task / Business Action: Clear destructive action confirmation dialog with explicit entity name typing
Business Outcome: Permanently cancelling an annual return or deleting a company requires typing 'DELETE' to confirm
Downstream Impact: Prevents catastrophic accidental clicks on destructive administrative actions
Notes: Nielsen Heuristic 5: Error Prevention. Type-to-confirm modal on high-risk operations.
